findings.description: `get` now accepts `params` as a named parameter but never forwards it to `self.request`. The call at line 671 passes only `**kwargs`, so `params` is silently dropped.
findings.rationale: Trigger: `session.get(url, params={'a': 1})` or the positional form `session.get(url, {'a': 1})`. Before this change `params` was in `kwargs` and reached `request`. Now it is captured by the named parameter and not passed on, so the query string is never added. Callers get responses for the wrong URL with no error.
